title: klvsjeju/wf-virus-longread

fastq.title: FASTQ file or folder
fastq.description: FASTQ files to use in the analysis.
fastq.help_text: Choose one .fastq/.fq file (optionally gzip compressed), a folder of FASTQ files for one sample, or a folder of barcode/sample subfolders. Use sample_sheet to assign aliases to subfolders.

reference_based_assembly.title: Reference-based assembly
reference_based_assembly.description: Enable reference based assembly istead of de novo assembly.

reference.title: Reference FASTA
reference.help_text: Upload/select your own uncompressed reference FASTA file. Used only when reference_based_assembly is enabled; no bundled reference is selected automatically.

analyse_unclassified.title: Include unclassified folder
analyse_unclassified.description: Analyse unclassifed reads from input directory. By default the workflow will not process reads in the un classified directory.

sample_sheet.title: Sample sheet CSV
sample_sheet.description: Optional barcode,alias CSV for multiplex input. Match either barcode-named or alias-named folders and use alias as the sample name.
sample_sheet.help_text: Folders absent from the sheet are ignored with a warning. Sheet entries without folders are recorded as missing input. Providing both barcode and alias folders for the same row is an error. Barcodes must use barcode plus at least two digits, all the same length. Barcodes and aliases must be unique. Alias must not begin with barcode. Optional type values are test_sample, positive_control, negative_control and no_template_control. Single-file and flat-folder inputs use the sample name or input-derived name.

sample.title: Sample name
sample.description: Optional name for one FASTQ file or a flat FASTQ folder. If empty, use the file stem or folder base name. For multiplex input, select a folder name or a sample sheet barcode/alias.
sample.help_text: Sample names use the wf-bacterial-genomes naming rules. Spaces in the final name become underscores. With a sample sheet, this field filters matching barcode or alias entries.

override_basecaller_cfg.title: Manual basecalling model
override_basecaller_cfg.description: Leave unset to infer from FASTQ headers. A manual selection overrides the inferred name.
override_basecaller_cfg.help_text: Leave unset for automatic model detection with fastcat. A header fallback supports explicit model tags and versioned models in RG:Z: read-group tags. A manual selection overrides detection. Reference mode prepares a compatible Clair3 1.x checkpoint for supported models.

flye_genome_size.title: Estimated genome size (bp)
flye_genome_size.description: Estimated genome size for de novo assembly in non-SI prefix format (e.g 5000000 for 5 Mb genome)

flye_opts.title: Additional Flye options
flye_opts.description: Extra Flye arguments, e.g. --meta --iterations 2 --asm-coverage 50. Input, output, threads and genome size are managed by the workflow.
flye_opts.help_text: Enter command-line arguments only. Quoted values are supported. Shell expansion, pipes and redirects are not executed.

mask_depth.title: Consensus N-mask depth
mask_depth.description: 0 preserves original behavior; low/zero depth can retain reference bases. Set e.g. 30 to mask depth below threshold.

mask_depth_opts.title: Additional mask depth options
mask_depth_opts.description: Extra samtools depth arguments used to compute depth and the low-coverage BED mask, e.g. -q 15 -Q 20. Mask threshold is set by mask_depth; 0 disables BED masking. Default depth options: -aa -J. Input and output are managed by the workflow.
mask_depth_opts.help_text: Enter command-line arguments only. Quoted values are supported. Shell expansion, pipes and redirects are not executed.

consensus_opts.title: Additional consensus options
consensus_opts.help_text: Enter command-line arguments only. To apply variants with allele frequency strictly greater than 50%, use --include 'FORMAT/AF>0.5'. AF is a fraction from 0 to 1, not a percentage. This example requires a numeric FORMAT/AF field in the input VCF. Quoted values are supported; shell expansion is not executed.

run_annotation.title: Run reference annotation
run_annotation.description: Optional snpEff annotation of variants. Disabled: provide unannotated VCF without requiring snpEff resources.

snpeff_config.title: snpEff.config
snpeff_config.description: Select the snpEff.config file supplied with your reference-specific annotation database. Example: D:\Annotation\vzv_poka\snpEff.config.
snpeff_config.help_text: Choose the configuration file, not genes.gff, genes.gbk or snpEffectPredictor.bin. It must define the database ID entered below. For the Dumas package, select D:\Annotation\vzv_dumus\snpEff.config.

snpeff_data.title: snpEff data folder
snpeff_data.description: Select the data folder containing the database subfolder. Example: D:\Annotation\vzv_poka\data.
snpeff_data.help_text: Choose the parent data folder, not data\VZV_pOka and not an individual file. The selected folder must contain <DB ID>\snpEffectPredictor.bin. For Dumas, select D:\Annotation\vzv_dumus\data.

snpeff_db.title: snpEff DB ID
snpeff_db.description: Enter the database subfolder name as text; do not select a file. Example: VZV_pOka for pOka, or VZV_Dumas for the existing Dumas package.
snpeff_db.help_text: The ID must match both the subfolder inside the selected data folder and the genome entry in snpEff.config. Example: data\VZV_pOka\snpEffectPredictor.bin means DB ID VZV_pOka. Match spelling and case exactly. Use the database matching the reference FASTA used for alignment.

out_dir.title: Output directory
out_dir.description: Optional. Leave unset to save in analysis_result inside the selected FASTQ folder, or beside a selected FASTQ file.

description: Human herpes virus: reference based analysis or de novo Flye contigs.
